evals.expected_output: One Operation from the canvas/plan was never implemented. The skill detects it, reports it as a concrete gap, and does not mark the scope as Verified.
evals.setup: Implement a feature but skip one Operation listed in the canvas, then run spdd-implement's Step 8 to mark it Implemented anyway.
assertions: The report explicitly names the missing Operation
The plan or canvas is not marked 'Status: Verified'
Nothing is moved to spdd/archive/ and spdd/specs/ is not modified

evals.expected_output: A Safeguards edge case has no existing test covering it. The skill writes and runs a targeted test for that exact scenario.
evals.setup: Implement a feature whose Safeguards section lists an edge case (e.g. related entity does not exist) with no corresponding test in the codebase.
assertions: A new test is written that targets the specific WHEN/THEN scenario from Safeguards
The new test is actually executed as part of verification
The report lists which Safeguards scenarios got a new test versus which were already covered

evals.expected_output: A legacy change migrated via spdd-migrate has no plans/ folder (spdd-implement now always requires one for new changes, but migrated changes predate that rule) and everything passes. The skill marks Status: Verified, folds the canvas into spdd/specs/<domain>.md, and moves the whole change folder to spdd/archive/.
evals.setup: Simulate a spdd-migrate result: place a canvas.md directly under spdd/changes/SPDD-slug/ with 'Status: Implemented' and no plans/ folder, with all Operations correctly implemented and tested.
assertions: spdd/specs/<domain>.md exists and contains the feature's Requirements/Operations after verification
The change folder no longer exists under spdd/changes/
The change folder now exists under spdd/archive/

evals.expected_output: A change has two plans; plan-01 passes verification but plan-02 is not yet implemented. The skill marks plan-01 as Verified but does NOT fold anything into spdd/specs/ or archive the change, since plan-02 is still pending.
evals.setup: Generate a canvas, split it into plan-01 and plan-02 with spdd-design, implement and verify only plan-01.
assertions: No changes are made to any file under spdd/specs/
The change folder remains under spdd/changes/, not spdd/archive/

evals.expected_output: A Norm from the canvas (e.g. a stated project convention) was not followed in the implementation. The skill detects it, reports the concrete violation, and does not mark the scope as Verified.
evals.setup: Implement a feature that violates a Norm explicitly listed in the canvas (e.g. wrong file naming convention, missing required pattern).
assertions: The report names the specific Norm violated and where
The plan or canvas is not marked 'Status: Verified'

evals.expected_output: The target spdd/specs/<domain>.md already lists an Entity that this change's canvas also lists (same name, no NEW/MODIFIED marker involved since Entities don't carry one). Folding back updates that Entity's row in place instead of adding a duplicate row.
evals.setup: Verify a change whose canvas Entities section includes an entity with the same name as one already present in spdd/specs/<domain>.md.
assertions: spdd/specs/<domain>.md's Entities table has exactly one row for that entity name after folding
The row reflects the current (possibly updated) notes/path, not a stale duplicate of the old one
